title: SQL 子查询 (Subquery)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (9/16)：标量子查询、IN/NOT IN、EXISTS/NOT EXISTS、ANY/ALL 与 FROM 子查询

content.tips: 查 orders 全部，其 user_id 等于（users 中 name 为 Tom 的 id）
content.content: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = 'Tom');

content.tips: 查 products 中 price 等于 products 最大 price 的行
content.content: SELECT * FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products);

content.tips: 查 users 中 id 落在（orders 里 amount 大于 1000 的 user_id）集合内的行
content.content: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 1000);

content.tips: 查 users 中 id 不在（orders 的 user_id）集合内的行
content.content: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders);

content.tips: 用 EXISTS 查有订单的用户：users u，子查询 SELECT 1 FROM orders o 关联 o.user_id = u.id
content.content: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);

content.tips: 用 NOT EXISTS 查没有订单的用户：users u，子查询 SELECT 1 FROM orders o 关联 o.user_id = u.id
content.content: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);

content.tips: 查 products 中 price 大于（category 为 book 的任一 price），用 ANY
content.content: SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ANY (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'book');

content.tips: 查 products 中 price 大于（category 为 book 的所有 price），用 ALL
content.content: SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ALL (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'book');

content.tips: FROM 里放子查询：orders 按 user_id 求 SUM(amount) 别名 total，外层表别名 t，取 t.user_id、t.total，筛 total 大于 1000
content.content: SELECT t.user_id, t.total FROM (SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) t WHERE t.total > 1000;
